artifacts.summary: Route (a) for HasForwardSlack refuted by a compiled climbing-register ladder path; route (b) regime with finite witness and three compiled entry lemmas; exact-shift reformulated as overshoot-then-up with a compiled spaced pigeonhole, slack transport, and (K2) room bound; cell-level statement on the witnessing path; phased plan recommendation.

memory_candidates.content: On a ladder path the pins are determined by the object walk (region length L gives start countdown L-1, read into the register at the preceding idle position), and the register is any 1-Lipschitz interpolation; a walk lifts iff L1-1 <= n + c + I1 and L_{k+1} <= 2 L_k + I_{k+1}. Deleting from z's region only shrinks the first distance, so every forward-slack obligation sits at the first region start.

The landed deletion lemmas are length-agnostic: d deletions of an l-block equal one deletion of a d*l-block. Exactness (a prescribed total) is obtained by overshoot-then-up: delete pigeonhole blocks until the total exceeds the target by less than budget*l, then raise by the overshoot with the free iterated duplication of a block kept intact below the deletions.
